correctness.rationale: Exact 512-triple temporal-history graph and 19 cyclic vertices produce Q3(z,u); its three-phase fixed-history subgraph produces Q1(z,u). The logarithmic derivative counts each primitive orbit once after division by 3. Independent direct original-rule exhaustive simulation at every n=3..17 matches weighted trace at u=2. The cyclic graph is irreducible with 3- and 4-cycles (primitive), exact rational positive Perron vector bounds the root; analytic perturbation and different cycle-weight means prove the LLN, CLT and b>0. The estimator refers only to orbit-averaged three-time occupation.

value.rationale: Rule73 magnetization oscillations are an explicit longstanding dynamical phenomenon. The exact three-phase orbit-population distribution for all rings, and its law of large numbers plus nondegenerate Gaussian fluctuations, quantify a motivated observable unavailable from published unweighted counts, and distinguish the uniform recurrent-orbit ensemble from random-initial attraction.
